newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Medinfar sues Sweden's Astra.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Medinfar sues Sweden's Astra.

text.p: Portuguese company Medinfar said it had sued Swedish pharmaceuticals concern Astra and its Lisbon subsidiary for 300 million escudos ($2 million) over allegations they had harmed its image.
A news release said Astra had made statements in the local media "aimed at negatively affecting the image of Medinfar and one of its products based on Omeprazole."
Omeprazole, prescribed for gastro-intestinal patients, competes with an Astra patent, Medinfar said.

Helmut Nowak, general manager of Astra Portuguesa-Produtos Farmaceuticos Lda, told Reuters: "This is a smokescreen. We have sued Medinfar for patent infringement in the past. I don't see big possibilities for them to win."
